description: This file contains shell script code that defines a series of performance tests for Git rebasing operations, including setup and execution of rebases with different configurations.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up the default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified rebase commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, with a description and a sequence of commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers, used for creating large diffs.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with given changes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
